_note: ONS inputs for tools/import_data.py's GBR region figures (V5.3). Read from the workbooks by script, never typed; re-verified cell by cell on 2026-11-06 (.superpowers/sdd/v5.3-sector-sources.md). GDP stands in for GVA: ONS publishes GDP (GVA plus taxes less subsidies on products) per head and in total at ITL1, and no GVA per head.

gdp.source: ONS, Regional gross domestic product: all International Territorial Level (ITL) regions, Table 5 (GDP at current market prices, pounds million), ITL1 rows, 2024 (provisional); published 23 September 2026

unemployment.source: ONS, Regional labour market: headline Labour Force Survey indicators for all regions (HI00), sheets *_p, unemployment rate, people aged 16 and over, seasonally adjusted, Jun-Aug 2026; UK from A01 Summary of labour market statistics (series MGSX), same period; released 20 October 2026
